name: Common Crawl CDX index
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: med: returns WARC offsets for shop pages (gaming.gen.tr 2025-10 hit, lang tur); fetching WARC byte ranges from data.commoncrawl.org gives historical price snapshots, but only sparse crawls per site
notes: Wildcard query url=forum.donanimhaber.com/* was reset (connection aborted) on one try; collinfo.json also reset once. Index files downloadable from data.commoncrawl.org (cc-index.paths.gz 200) as bulk alternative. Trendyol/HB/sahibinden out of scope.

name: Arquivo.pt CDX
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: med: it did hold gaming.gen.tr (2025-06 snapshot); coverage of Turkish shops is incidental
notes: Returns CDXJ lines with WARC filename/offset; replay via arquivo.pt/wayback/<timestamp>/<url>.

name: Arquivo.pt full-text search API
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: low: 44k hits for the query but pages are archived copies, mostly Portuguese-crawled; no structured prices
notes: JSON with title/snippet/originalURL/tstamp.

name: Internet Archive Wayback Availability API
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: med: closest snapshot lookup for small shops (returned 2026-09-16 snapshot of gaming.gen.tr)
notes: Works over http://archive.org while CDX endpoint does not (see next).

name: Internet Archive Wayback CDX
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: high if reachable: full snapshot list per URL, enables price history for small shops/forums
notes: Connection reset by peer on both attempts from this environment (proxy/IP block). Retry from another network or via Wayback availability API + direct /web/<ts>/ fetch.

name: Memento TimeTravel aggregator
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: low: just a meta-aggregator of IA/Arquivo/etc.; adds nothing we can't query directly
notes: http: DNS did not resolve; https: proxy CONNECT 502. Service appears down/unreachable.

name: archive.today / archive.ph
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: low: no API; automated access against ToS and blocked
notes: Connection reset. Not recommended.

name: UK Web Archive / UKGWA CDX
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: low: UK government sites only; irrelevant to Turkish shops
notes: HTTP 405 Human Verification page.

name: Common Crawl CC-NEWS dataset
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: low: news articles only; occasional handheld launch price mentions
notes: Listing reachable. WARC files large.

name: Common Crawl web graph (host/domain)
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: low: link graph only, no prices; useful just for discovering Turkish shop domains
notes: My guessed release path returned 404 NoSuchKey; need actual release name from commoncrawl.org/web-graphs.

name: GDELT DOC 2.0 API
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: low: news articles, search was noisy (unrelated Turkish results)
notes: Free JSON; could surface launch/price news only.

name: Wikidata SPARQL
rate_limit: needs descriptive User-Agent; 60s query timeout; ~5 parallel
example_query: see notes/report: label-based VALUES query on rdfs:label with P176 manufacturer, P577 date, P880 CPU, P2928 RAM
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: med for spec enrichment, none for prices: PS Vita returns CPU+RAM, Switch Lite CPU; modern PC handhelds (Steam Deck, ROG Ally) mostly missing
notes: Class-based queries (P31 wd:Q941818) return only 1 item: modern consoles are typed 'product model'/'electronic device model'/'handheld game console model' (Lenovo Legion Go). P31/P279* Q941818 returns toy-like noise (Casio LCD games, TMNT). Use name-based VALUES lookup. wbsearchentities API rate-limited (429) after SPARQL calls.

name: eBay Browse API
rate_limit: 5,000 calls/day default on free developer program
example_query: GET ...search?q=steam+deck&filter=... with OAuth app token + X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: med: global used/new listing prices (USD/EUR) for reference vs Turkish prices; Turkey has no eBay marketplace
notes: Unauthenticated returned 403 (expected). Signup: developer.ebay.com, create keyset, client-credentials OAuth. Not fully tested without key.

name: AliExpress affiliate/open API
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: med: cheap Anbernic/Retroid/Ayaneo prices, Turkey-shippable
notes: Not tested; requires affiliate approval. Documented from knowledge only.

name: Amazon PA-API 5 / Creators API
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: med: amazon.com.tr prices if associate account qualifies
notes: Requires Associates account with qualifying sales; not tested.

name: Brave Search API
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: med: URL/snippet discovery of shops, snippets sometimes include prices
notes: Endpoint answers; without key returns 422 requiring x-subscription-token. Works once key obtained.

name: Google Programmable Search JSON API
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: low-med: 100 q/day, snippets only
notes: 403 PERMISSION_DENIED without key; Google has restricted new signups for whole-web engines.

name: Bing Web Search API
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: low: retired Aug 2025, replacement is paid Grounding
notes: Not tested; excluded.

name: SerpApi
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: excluded
notes: Excluded per brief (paid).

name: Akakce / Cimri official API
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: none: no public API found; both are price aggregators and would be ideal if accessible
notes: Cimri shows security verification. Akakce 404. Both are direct-scrape territory, out of scope.

name: Frankfurter (ECB) exchange rates
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: high for FX normalization: returned 1 USD = 50.368 TRY on 2026-11-13
notes: Already used by the project. Historical: /v1/2025-01-01..?symbols=TRY.

name: TCMB EVDS
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: high for official TRY rates and CPI series (inflation-adjust historical prices)
notes: Unkeyed request got HTTP 302 redirect (to login/new EVDS). Free registration at evds2.tcmb.gov.tr; endpoint domain may have changed; untested with key.

name: Hugging Face Datasets API
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: low: only found turkish-ecommerce-product-returns and synthetic price sets; no console price data
notes: Search 'price turkish' returned []. Check licence per dataset.

name: Kaggle datasets list API
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: low: unauthenticated search returned [] (likely needs creds for results)
notes: Datasets have per-dataset licences; check before use.

name: Icecat Open Catalog
rate_limit: free tier for open brands only
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: med for specs/images (EAN lookups) of Asus/Lenovo/etc, no prices; Steam Deck/Anbernic unlikely covered
notes: icecat.biz returned 301; open.icecat.biz connection reset. Needs account.

name: Common Crawl bulk columnar index (S3/Athena)
example_query: download cc-index.paths.gz then filter parquet by url_host_tld='tr'
usefulness_for_handheld_prices: med: offline filtering of all .tr domains for product pages avoids per-URL queries
notes: Path list answered 200 (gzip).
